key.note: Preserve source identifiers in an audit ledger; map regenerated internal IDs and target numbering. Never assume internal IDs survive migration.

structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. Retain both external project/WBS identifiers and internal references. Rebuild hierarchy with target key maps; do not copy internal object numbers. Project costs are reference history. Status, networks, settlement rules, budgets, commitments and investment measures require a supported business interface and separate scope agreement. Separate original budget, supplements, returns, releases and transfers by verified value type and transaction semantics; do not sum all BPGE/BPJA rows as available budget. Currency, object ownership, fiscal year and availability-control settings must be enriched and approved. Reconcile overall and annual budget separately through a supported budget interface.
